a little bit about us

Your favourite
corner of Bhubaneswar

Tucked into Acharya Vihar, The Cafe Heaven started as just a little dream — good coffee, honest food, and a place where you could actually breathe. Now it's become one of those spots people keep coming back to. The kind of place where you'll sit longer than you planned.

"Ambience of the place has good young vibes with soothing music in the background."

what we've got

Our Menu

Avg per person: ₹200–600

★ Most ordered

Nutella KitKat Shake

Thick, indulgent, and dangerously good. You'll probably order it twice.

★ Fan favourite

Hazelnut Cappuccino

Silky espresso with hazelnut warmth and a cloud of foam on top.

Doppio

A straight double espresso. No drama, just coffee.

Iced Latte

Cold espresso over ice — simple and refreshing.

Vanilla Frappe

Blended iced coffee with a sweet vanilla kick.

Ginger Lemon Tea

Zingy and warm — great for when you want something a little different.

★ Try this one

Roast Garlic Chicken Pizza

One of the most recommended items here. Crispy base, generous toppings.

★ Popular

Farm House Pizza

Fresh veggies on a perfectly crisped base. A solid go-to.

Roasted Tomato Basil Soup

Slow-roasted, velvety, and exactly what you need on a slow afternoon.

Cheese Corn Sandwich

Melted cheese and sweet corn — grilled to a satisfying crunch.

Chicken Lasagna

Layered right — tender chicken, béchamel, tomato. The real deal.

Chicken Pasta with Mixed Sauce

Al dente pasta with a medley of sauces that actually work together.

Garlic Bread with Herbs

Herb-buttered, golden, crusty. Order it alongside anything.

Chicken Cheese Mac & Cheese

Loaded with chicken and a four-cheese blend. No regrets.

★ Showstopper

Sizzling Brownie

It arrives sizzling — warm, fudgy brownie with vanilla ice cream. You'll hear it before you see it.
